name: Tinkatink
description: Tinkatink, the Metalsmith Pokémon. Able to evolve into Tinkatuff. A Fairy and Steel type.
pokedex_entries: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.
